claims.text: These answers use regional context. An area or climate grid does not establish conditions in a particular field.
A rainfall graph shows water depth over the labeled period, usually in millimeters. A missing point means unknown, not no rain. Historical rain is not a forecast or the water available to crop roots.
Evidence “rain-2024-02” remains unknown or needs review: missing, partial, stale, conflicting or unverified quality.

evidence.spatial_support: Software contract fixture; no scientific validation
limitations: No measurement supplied. Coordinates are an example, not a restriction.
